processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Milled in a planetary ball mill (Retsch PM 400/2) at 200 rpm; ball-to-powder ratio 10:1; WC vials and WC balls; toluene used as a process-control reagent to avoid oxidation; milling stopped intermittently for 20 min after every 1 h to avoid overheating; 2–3 g of powder sampled after every 5 h to study phase evolution.

structures.overall_structure: Multiphase structure after 30 h of mechanical alloying: BCC (major phase) + γ-brass type + residual/undissolved Si; no B2-type phase has formed yet at 30 h.

characterization_methods.technique: High-resolution X-Ray diffraction (XRD) with Rietveld refinement
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: EMPYREAN, PANalytical XRD with Co-Kα source (40 kV, 40 mA, scan rate 5° min⁻¹); Rietveld refinement in GSAS-II
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase identification, lattice parameter, phase/weight fraction, crystallite size, microstrain and dislocation density of the milled powder
characterization_methods.key_findings: 30 h milled powder consists of BCC (73.0 wt%, a = 0.286 nm), γ-brass type (23.5 wt%, a = 0.872 nm) and residual Si (3.5 wt%, a = 0.543 nm); refinement quality GoF = 1.14, χ² = 1.29

characterization_methods.technique: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and image analysis (particle size histograms)
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Evo 18 Carl Zeiss SEM; particle size measured using ImageJ software
characterization_methods.purpose: Determine size, shape and morphology of the milled powder particles
characterization_methods.key_findings: Average particle size of the 30 h milled powder is ~5 ± 1.5 µm (Fig. 2(h)); particle population becomes finer and more homogeneous with milling time

computational_details.simulation_method: Rietveld refinement (general structural analysis system, GSAS-II) with dislocation-density and microstrain analysis

analytical_models.model_name: Dislocation density from microstrain and crystallite size
analytical_models.model_note: Burgers vector b = (√3/2)·a for BCC; the resulting BCC dislocation density for the 30 h powder is 2.67 ×10^18 m^-2 (Table 2).

unmapped_findings: For the 30 h milled powder, the Rietveld refinement quality metrics are GoF = 1.14 and χ² = 1.29 (Table 2).
The B2-type phase is absent in the 30 h milled powder (Table 2 lists only BCC, γ-brass type and Si columns for 30 h); the partially ordered B2-type phase appears only at 35 h of milling.
The average particle size of the 30 h milled powder is ~5 ± 1.5 µm (Fig. 2(h)).

The dislocation density in Table 2 is tabulated only for the BCC phase for all milling times; for the 30 h powder it is 2.67 ×10^18 m^-2 while γ-brass type and Si dislocation densities are not reported.

Phase-evolution sequence with milling stated in the text: elemental peaks vanish by ~5 h, Al alloys first, Ni/Mn peaks disappear after 20 h, solid solution forms after 25 h (BCC a = 0.286 nm + γ-brass type a = 0.872 nm), and the B2-type ordered phase coexists from 35 h; thus at 30 h the powder is BCC + γ-brass type + residual Si.
